title: fix(studio): a deleted package leaves Studio's recently viewed row, and no copilot opens beside a package that is not there
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQvXLoyHKgDngdbpecXci6e)_

Fixes #32615

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `useRecentItems()` from `@object-ui/app-shell` gains `removeRecentItem(id)`; no `@object-ui/i18n` pack key is added.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:Studio 首页「最近访问」只列出服务端软件包清单里仍存在的包;在 Studio 里删除软件包时同步从最近访问存储中移除;打开不存在的软件包地址时,「未找到包」页面旁不再挂副驾。
- 为什么改:删掉的包仍留在「最近访问」里、只显示 id,点进去像一个空的可编辑应用,副驾还提示「编辑此应用」,容易在已删除的包 id 下继续写草稿。
- 风险与回滚:只改前端 Studio 三处判断与一个新的 `removeRecentItem`;不改接口、不改元数据。回滚即 revert 本 PR,最近访问恢复为只按类型过滤。
- 先看:`BuilderLanding.tsx`(recentPackages 的过滤)、`PackageSwitcher.tsx`(onManageChanged 判定删除后移除存储项)、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`(slotHost 与 aiSlot 在 pkgMissing 时不渲染)。
- 两分钟验证:在 Studio 打开一个包,删除它,回到 Studio 首页:「最近访问」里不再有它;再直接打开它的地址:只看到「未找到包」和返回 Studio 首页的按钮,右侧没有副驾。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）接手 domain:ui#1 留下的本 PR，返工一轮：上一版 CI 红，原因是新加的包列表请求在四个旧测试里打到了真实网络，现已在测试替身里补上，产品代码未改。之前未测的本地测试、类型检查和 5 处消融这轮都补测了。`removeRecentItem` 是公开 hook 返回值上新增的一个函数，只增不减，已按默认档复核通过。CI 全绿，按队列落地。

## What changes
- **Studio landing, "Recently viewed"** (`BuilderLanding.tsx`): a recent `package` entry is listed only while the package list the landing already loads still names it. The read is `GET /api/v1/packages`, the same request `fetchPackages()` sends; `fetchListedPackageIds()` shares it and also names the kernel packages the cards hide, so a kernel package someone opened keeps its entry. A deleted package used to keep its card, labelled by its id. The stored entry is not dropped here: the list is the active organization's, the recent store is the user's.
- **Delete from Studio** (`PackageSwitcher.tsx`, `onManageChanged`): when the refreshed list comes back without the managed package (the existing deletion signal, the same one that navigates away), `removeRecentItem('package:ID')` drops it from the store. A failed refresh drops nothing, as it navigates nothing.
- **Store** (`RecentItemsProvider.tsx`): new `removeRecentItem(id)`; an id the list does not hold writes nothing. The no-provider fallback gets a no-op.
- **Workbench for a missing package** (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`): the "Package not found" state with its way back to the Studio landing already existed on `main` (the `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708` pins); this PR reuses it and adds no new widget. What was left: the right slot's copilot stayed mounted beside it and offered to edit the app. `slotHost` and the injected `aiSlot` aside are now off while `pkgMissing` is set.

## Tests
Added and replaced cases in the existing harness files, each as a top-level `describe`:
- `BuilderLanding.recentPackages-11863.test.tsx`: a package the list no longer has is not listed (CONTROL: a live one beside it is); a gone entry does not take a row slot; only gone packages means no section; CONTROL: a kernel package the cards hide stays listed; the stored entry is kept by the render filter. The old case "a package the list no longer has draws its machine name" pinned the defect and is replaced.
- `StudioDesignSurface.packageDeletionInference.test.tsx`: a real deletion drops the package's entry from the real `RecentItemsProvider` store and from localStorage, and the sibling stays; CONTROL: a failed refresh and a still-listed package keep the entry.
- `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708.test.tsx`: no built-in copilot and no injected `aiSlot` copilot on the not-found state; CONTROL: a listed package keeps both.
- `BuilderLanding.orgScope-11553`, `.accessibleNames-12510`, `.setupExit-12513`, `.newPackageDeepLink-26614` (rework round 1): these four suites doubled `fetchPackages` but not the listed-ids read the landing now sends beside it. That read reached the real `GET /api/v1/packages`, and the network-escape guard failed them (Test UI shards 3, 4, 5 and 8 at f7624414). Both reads are now answered from the same module double. Each file also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of a test file the branch edits. No product code changed in this round.

- vitest, `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` and `packages/app-shell/src/context/` (under the verify lock, at 4147020c, one commit before the head; the head only adds the lint import to four test files): Test Files 339 passed (339), Tests 2610 passed (2610), VERDICT command-exit 0.

- Ablations at d07ff598, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold` then `--restore`, with the restored blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after each:
  - A1 `BuilderLanding.tsx`, the filter `listedPackageIds.has(item.name)` made always true: `recentPackages-11863` goes red on 3 cases ("a package the list no longer has is not listed", "the gone entry does not take a slot", "only gone packages: no section at all"); the CONTROL cases stay green. The first A1 attempt was a no-op (the tool refused because the replacement text was already in the file, and the file was restored); the run after it is not counted.
  - A2 `PackageSwitcher.tsx`, the `removeRecentItem` call deleted: `packageDeletionInference` "REAL deletion: the deleted package leaves the store, the sibling stays" goes red, 1 failed of 9.
  - A3 `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `slotHost` without `!pkgMissing`: `notFound-26708` "the built-in copilot slot is not mounted on the not-found state" goes red, 1 failed of 13.
  - A4 `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the `aiSlot` aside guard made always true: `notFound-26708` "an injected copilot (the cloud `aiSlot`) is not drawn on the not-found state" goes red, 1 failed of 13.

- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at d07ff598: 37 families derived, all 37 exit 0 (the `ui` `scripts/` vitest family: Test Files 171 passed, 2 skipped). The `--ran` reconciliation: "37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 37 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 11 changed source and test files: exit 0, 0 errors and 46 warnings. Every warning is on an existing line of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` or `RecentItemsProvider.tsx`; none is on a line this PR adds.
- `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations.
</details>

## Acceptance notes
- The card's not-found sentence: the existing `engine.studio.notFound.package` copy, "Package not found. No package with the id ... is installed here", and its zh translation carry the meaning. No new key and no copy change.
- Staging opened an editable workbench where `main` draws the not-found state. The likely cause is a console build older than the not-found state, or a host-mounted surface. That cannot be confirmed from this tree. While the list read is in flight, the builder is drawn as before (the fail direction is unchanged).

## Verification
See the details block above. Nothing is left NOT MEASURED locally. CI at d07ff598: `Test UI` success (9 of 9 shards), `Type Check UI`, `Lint UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`, `Test Core`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Lint & Repo Gates` and `Dogfood Regression Gate` all success.
